hotels.title: Stylish Brisbane CBD Stay on Elizabeth Street
hotels.description: Set on Elizabeth Street in Brisbane’s CBD, this design-led retreat places you moments from the Brisbane River, Queen Street Mall and the City Botanic Gardens. Contemporary rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows, with many framing sweeping views across the river and South Bank. Start the day at the hotel’s all-day dining venue before strolling to Eagle Street Pier for waterfront dining or Howard Smith Wharves for polished bars and acclaimed restaurants. Cultural highlights including QAGOMA, the Queensland Performing Arts Centre and the Museum of Brisbane are all within easy reach
